_comment: The specification register: what is presented, at which version, and which version is current.
One file, because a version typed into a README table, a nav list and a page header is three versions
that drift. The README index and the site navigation are both generated from this file, and
`engine/.pi/scripts/validate-spec-register.sh` fails when anything disagrees with it.
A `gate` is one question the dispatcher asks before a step may run. `spec` names the document that
answers it; null means the question is answered in a requirement section of another document
(`documented_in`), which is the honest state until a gate earns its own specification.

gates.title: Preconditions
gates.question: may this step dispatch at all?

gates.title: Requirements
gates.question: which operator obligations does the step leave unmet?

gates.title: Capacity
gates.question: does the declared cap admit this consumption?

gates.title: Approval
gates.question: has a human bound to this consequence signed it off?
